column2: Today I am sharing the Yazinc AI Toolkit, a public library of 52 reusable AI-agent skills built to help developers and teams move from an idea to verified delivery. It covers software engineering, Laravel, security, AI systems, product design, databases, data operations, analytics, and more. Explore the complete toolkit and choose the workflow your project needs: https://yaz-inc.github.io/yazinc-ai-toolkit/

Good software should demonstrate its ideas, not only describe them. The Yazinc AI Toolkit now includes two live skill exhibitions: Animated Glow Border in the hero and Warp Speed Light Trail in the footer. Each effect is documented as a reusable skill with accessibility, performance, and implementation guidance. See both live: https://yaz-inc.github.io/yazinc-ai-toolkit/

One toolkit, one installer, multiple AI coding agents. Yazinc AI Toolkit supports Codex, Cursor, Claude Code, and Antigravity. Install the library once, select a skill by name, and describe the result you need in your active project. The same reusable workflow can travel with you across supported agents. Repository: https://github.com/Yaz-inc/yazinc-ai-toolkit

AI agents become more useful when reusable knowledge includes clear guardrails. Every Yazinc AI Toolkit skill has a focused purpose, an actionable workflow, safety boundaries, validation steps, and completion evidence. The goal is simple: help agents deliver repeatable results without sacrificing security, stability, reliability, or compliance. Explore the library: https://yaz-inc.github.io/yazinc-ai-toolkit/

Building with Laravel? Yazinc AI Toolkit includes focused workflows for DataTables CRUD, role-based permissions, soft deletion and trash, activity logging, secure AI provider settings, deployment recovery, global forms, maintenance controls, and more. Use the skill that matches your outcome instead of rebuilding the same solution from scratch. Browse Laravel delivery skills: https://yaz-inc.github.io/yazinc-ai-toolkit/

Quality cannot be an afterthought before launch. Yazinc AI Toolkit brings together end-to-end testing, API contract testing, application security review, supply-chain security, database reliability, CI/CD release gates, performance testing, accessibility, and observability. Start with a proven checklist and finish with evidence. Explore engineering and quality skills: https://yaz-inc.github.io/yazinc-ai-toolkit/

Data work needs more than a query. The Yazinc AI Toolkit includes reusable skills for profiling, cleaning, validation, SQL engineering, SQL performance, NoSQL, reconciliation, migration, analytics engineering, pipelines, data-quality contracts, lineage, governance, and decision-ready reporting. Choose the right workflow before touching the data: https://yaz-inc.github.io/yazinc-ai-toolkit/

Production AI needs evaluation and operations, not only a model call. Yazinc AI Toolkit includes skills for AI evaluation and red teaming, DeepEval regression testing, RAG evaluation, AI observability, and vector-database readiness. Measure quality, safety, cost, latency, retrieval, and failure behavior before users discover the problems. Explore AI-system skills: https://yaz-inc.github.io/yazinc-ai-toolkit/

Product design is part of reliable delivery. Yazinc AI Toolkit covers UI and UX workflows, Animated Glow Border, Warp Speed Light Trail, Figma and Canva coordination, design-to-code implementation, design systems, and screen-reader testing. Build experiences that are polished, responsive, accessible, and practical to maintain. See the product-design collection: https://yaz-inc.github.io/yazinc-ai-toolkit/

Not every useful technology should become an installable skill. That is why Yazinc AI Toolkit also includes smart implementation playbooks. Each playbook explains what the solution is, how to apply it safely, and provides a copy-ready starter prompt. Current examples cover React with Puter.js, Next.js with Supabase, reliable n8n automation, and private local AI with Ollama. Explore the playbooks: https://yaz-inc.github.io/yazinc-ai-toolkit/#playbooks

Reusable knowledge should be easy to discover. The Yazinc AI Toolkit public site lets you search and filter the complete catalog, read every skill, copy instructions, and open a simple usage guide. The interface supports English, Spanish, French, and German, while skill names remain consistent for reliable agent invocation. Explore it here: https://yaz-inc.github.io/yazinc-ai-toolkit/

Every completed project can make the next project better. Yazinc AI Toolkit includes a contribution workflow for turning repeatable lessons into reusable skills. Generalize the solution, remove secrets and client-specific details, record provenance, validate the workflow, and update the public catalog. Explore the toolkit, apply a skill, and help the library keep growing: https://github.com/Yaz-inc/yazinc-ai-toolkit
